desc_en: Single-location transform in Skopje Old Bazaar: one recurring hero chef sets an empty table, plates a traditional meal step-by-step, and the space fills with warm life. Start and end match the same camera angle for a clear before/after payoff, avoiding stock visuals and any readable signage.
music: Warm Balkan percussion and double bass groove, 96 bpm, subtle time-lapse ticks building to a bright, celebratory lift.
vo_mk: Во Чаршија, сè почнува од празна маса.
Топло јадење, свежи бои, мирис што буди.
Кога ќе стигнат луѓето, масата оживува.

shots.kf: Medium-wide 16:9 from a fixed corner of a small stone-walled room in Skopje Old Bazaar, low wooden ceiling beams, warm plaster, one rustic wooden table centered. The hero chef (male, early 30s, short dark hair, trimmed stubble, white shirt, dark apron) stands beside an empty place setting: plain ceramic plate, fork and knife, folded linen. Late-afternoon amber window light, earthy browns and creams, 35mm, photorealistic, no readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: Chef gently sets down the folded linen beside the empty plate. Camera makes a slow, smooth push-in of about 30 cm, keeping the table perfectly centered and the room steady over 5 seconds.
shots.end_kf: Same fixed corner angle and table position in the same stone-walled Old Bazaar room. The hero chef in identical clothes has aligned the cutlery and placed a simple water glass. The plate is still empty, but the table looks intentionally prepared. Late-afternoon amber light remains consistent, earthy palette, 35mm photorealistic, no readable text or signage.

shots.kf: Tight 16:9 close-up on the same table surface: the plain ceramic plate sits empty in the foreground; in the background, the hero chef’s hands (clean, ungloved) hold a wooden board with sliced tomatoes and cucumbers. Soft side light from the same window, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, 50mm, photorealistic. No logos, no readable packaging, no text; only food, plate, linen, and hands visible.
shots.motion: Chef’s hands slide the first slices onto the plate in a neat ring. Camera performs a gentle right-to-left slider move about 20 cm while maintaining focus on the plate for 5 seconds.
shots.end_kf: Same close-up angle and distance. The plate is now half-built: tomatoes and cucumbers laid evenly, a few green pepper strips added. The hero chef’s hands hover as if mid-process, the same window light and shallow depth remain, 50mm photorealistic, no text or branding.

shots.kf: Medium 16:9 on the same table, same corner perspective as Shot 1 but slightly tighter. The hero chef leans in, adding a mound of white grated cheese by hand to the salad. A small bowl of cheese sits to the side, unbranded and text-free. Warm late-afternoon light, gentle shadows on the stone wall, earthy palette with fresh reds and greens, 40mm lens, photorealistic, faces and hands clear and simple, no readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: Chef sprinkles the final cheese topping in one continuous motion, then lightly rotates the plate to present it. Camera executes a slow, subtle tilt down toward the plate, ending on the finished dish within 5 seconds.
shots.end_kf: Same framing and room. The salad is fully plated and centered; the bowl has been moved slightly back. The hero chef’s hands withdraw, leaving a clean, appetizing plate as the focal point. Warm light and color balance remain consistent, 40mm photorealistic, no signs, logos, or readable text.

shots.kf: Wide 16:9 from the exact same corner as Shot 1, showing the whole table and surrounding stone room. The table holds the finished salad but only one place setting; the chairs are empty and slightly pulled back. The hero chef stands at the edge of frame in the same outfit, checking the table calmly. Late-afternoon light, warm and quiet mood, 28mm lens, photorealistic, no readable text, no signage, simple background props only.
shots.motion: Chef pulls one chair in toward the table with a single smooth movement. Camera makes a slow lateral dolly left about 40 cm, revealing more of the table’s front edge while keeping composition stable for 5 seconds.
shots.end_kf: Same wide corner view. Two additional place settings now appear neatly arranged on the same table (matching plate, cutlery, linen), implying the meal is for company. The hero chef remains in frame in the same position, warm light unchanged, 28mm photorealistic, no readable text or branding.

shots.kf: Wide 16:9 end frame from the identical fixed corner angle as Shot 1, matching composition for a clear transform. The table looks intentionally sparse again in mood: the plated salad sits centered, but the room is still calm and waiting; chairs are present with empty seats. The hero chef stands just behind the table, hands relaxed at his sides, same clothing and grooming. Warm golden light, earthy tones, 28mm photorealistic, no readable text anywhere, clean safe-area composition for end card.
shots.motion: Two guests (only partial silhouettes and hands, no clear faces) step into frame and take their seats as the chef slides in a second dish beside the salad. Camera performs a gentle pull-back, revealing the now lively, full table in 5 seconds.
shots.end_kf: Same fixed corner view and table position for the final after. The table is now full and inviting: salad plus two additional simple dishes and shared bread, three place settings occupied by cropped, non-identifiable guests (hands and shoulders only), warm ambient glow. The hero chef remains visible at the edge, satisfied and still. Photorealistic, no text or logos; clear empty-to-full transformation with end-card safe space.
